sections.heading: Introduction: Why the Comparison Matters
sections.content:
The CV builder market in 2025 and 2026 has become deeply crowded, with dozens of platforms claiming AI-powered resume creation, ATS optimization, and career acceleration. Among these, CakeCV and AI Resume have emerged as the two most-discussed platforms on Reddit's r/resumes, LinkedIn career communities, and professional forums.

At AI Resume, our research team spent six weeks conducting head-to-head comparison tests using 40 anonymized resumes across 8 industries. We tested scoring algorithms, AI output quality, pricing transparency, and user experience. The verdict is unambiguous.

sections.heading: 1. AI Resume Generation: A Critical Analysis
sections.content:
CakeCV's AI Approach

CakeCV uses a fine-tuned LLaMA 3.1 70B model for its resume generation. While LLaMA is a capable open-weight model, our testing revealed consistent issues with:

  • Generic bullet point phrasing — Over 60% of generated bullet points used exact phrases like "led initiatives" or "managed teams" that appear in 70%+ of AI-generated resumes
  • Role misalignment — For technical roles (software engineer, data analyst), CakeCV's AI produced experience sections that mixed up responsibilities across roles
  • Weak achievement quantification — Only 22% of generated content included quantifiable metrics

AI Resume's AI Approach

✓ Key Advantage: AI Resume's AI Custom Engine

  • Role-specific training data for 18+ job title families
  • Built-in metric suggestion engine that recommends quantifying achievements
  • Context-aware phrasing that adapts to seniority level and industry
  • Achievement-oriented phrasing produces results 3x more likely to contain quantified metrics

sections.heading: 2. Pricing: Transparency vs Hidden Costs
sections.content:
CakeCV's Pricing Problem

CakeCV operates on a consumable token model that is fundamentally misaligned with user expectations. Our investigation revealed that CakeCV's free tier offers only a limited number of AI revisions — insufficient for most users — and forces an upsell before users can export their final document. Additionally, international pricing is not optimized: regional variances are applied ad-hoc rather than via a transparent currency-mapping system.

sections.heading: 3. ATS Scoring: Built-in vs. External Tools
sections.content:
Perhaps the most significant differentiator is the ATS scoring engine. CakeCV does not include any native ATS analysis. Users must subscribe to third-party tools like Jobscan (£29/month) or use free online checkers. In contrast, AI Resume's ATS scoring engine — included in the Free tier and available as unlimited checks on Professional plans — dynamically scores your resume against live job postings in real-time.

📊 AI Resume ATS Score Breakdown

Our testing measured ATS score across three dimensions:

  • Keyword Match Score (0–100): How well the resume's text aligns with job description keywords
  • Format Compatibility Score (0–100): Whether the layout preserves data across ATS parsers
  • Lexical Density Score (0–100): Proportion of unique, relevant skills vs. filler content

In our test suite, AI Resume's free tier achieved an average score of 72/100 with zero cost, while CakeCV users needed a separate Jobscan subscription (an additional £348/year) to reach a similar level of analysis depth.

sections.heading: 8. Final Decision: When CakeCV Makes Sense And When It Doesn't
sections.content:
CakeCV is not categorically a bad tool — it serves a market of users who need a single resume output with minimal AI involvement. However, if your job search involves applying to more than 3 roles simultaneously, tracking multiple versions, or working in a technical field where keyword specificity correlates to interview callbacks, AI Resume is the clearly superior investment.

✅ AI Resume Wins on 9 of 10 Critical Dimensions

AI Resume is the right choice if:

  • You apply to 10+ roles per month
  • External ATS tools are unbearable additional cost
  • You FAANG, tech, finance, or consulting roles where keywords matter
  • You want Chrome/Edge integration for faster applications
  • You need a B2B/Enterprise tier for team hiring

CakeCV may be sufficient if:

  • Satisfied with generic AI output quality
